definition: This dimension controls how cursed items are handled within the item identification system, varying from benign curses to severe consequences that affect gameplay. It includes the ways in which players can identify, remove, or deal with curses on items.
exclusion_criteria: All items are neutral with no negative effects.
Identification reveals all item properties without risk.
inclusion_criteria: Cursed items can have negative effects when equipped or used.
Players can find ways to identify or remove curses through gameplay.
title: Curse Mechanics in Item Identification
